tweet.text:
A) from our Bucket Launchpad review:

H-05, the most creative bug in the report. The attacker calls unlock on the PoolManager, and inside that callback forces a healthy launch into refund mode, then refunds first.

One tx. Full rug.

Full report (31 findings, all major fixed) 👇
http://github.com/SB-Security/audits/blob/master/reports/Bucket-Launchpad-Security-Review.pdf
